findings.evidence: src/lib/db.ts imports `PrismaPg` from `@prisma/adapter-pg` (`import { PrismaPg } from "@prisma/adapter-pg";` and `new PrismaPg({ connectionString })`), which is Prisma's PostgreSQL driver adapter. src/lib/db.ts is itself one of the code inputs listed for this dispatch, so the engine is in fact determinable from an input the document already cites (it references `@/lib/db` by name in the same sentence).

findings.message: The doc claims the database engine could not be confirmed from inputs, but `src/lib/db.ts` (an input to this dispatch, and the very file cited in this sentence) constructs the Prisma client with `new PrismaPg(...)` from `@prisma/adapter-pg`, which is Prisma's PostgreSQL adapter - directly indicating PostgreSQL rather than an unconfirmable engine.
